notes:
Lead source: inbound (signup) from product landing page. Small wellness platform that integrates booking, notes, and post-visit follow-ups for independent therapists and clinics. Primary ask: add a lightweight chat assistant (support + basic triage) and auto-summarize session notes for clinicians.

Key constraints / verbalized on calls: 
- "We are HIPAA-adjacent — we try not to send PHI but sometimes clinical context will slip in. Need clear guidance and controls." — customer quote.
- Wants hosted API (self-serve) for speed; prefers staying on public cloud for now.
- Critical questions: retention TTL per request, ability to disable request logging for specific API keys, opt-out of model training on their data, and short-term data residency assurances.
- Latency/throughput: low QPS (<<10), latency tolerance ~300–500ms for chat responses, cost-sensitive (prefers lower-cost open models if quality acceptable).
- Model preference: open models ok, but wants Redwood guidance on which models have smaller retention surface and cheaper unit cost. Interested in embedding-based doc search for knowledge base and appointment workflows.
- Security: asked about SOC2 status, audit logs access for admin, KMS integration for key encryption, and sample retention policy they can show to their counsel.
- Risk posture: will not send explicit PHI initially; legal team will decide whether to route PHI through hosted product.

Sales/technical notes: 
- AE (Maya) demo'd hosted quickstart and showed how to rotate API keys. SE (Jordan) to prepare a short doc showing: 1) how to set TTL for logs, 2) sample API call that redacts PII client-side, 3) wording for 'not for PHI' in TOS for now.
- Suggested next steps on call: send retention policy template + security FAQ, and schedule 30m security follow-up next week.

Quotes / customer tone: pragmatic, wants low-friction onboarding. "If you can give us an easy opt-out for logging and a short legal-friendly retention blurb, we can start paying next month."

Suggested internal playbook: treat as classic SMB hosted API motion — focus on enabling self-serve onboarding while answering security Qs quickly. Keep resources light: one SE touch (Jordan) + AE follow-up. If they scale beyond 50k tokens/day consider Dedicated conversation.
